recipes.label: Support and reassure
recipes.description: Acknowledge a difficulty, then offer grounded support. Use only when the response does both.

recipes.label: Explore and consider
recipes.description: Open a question or possibility, then thoughtfully weigh it. Use for exploration followed by interpretation.

recipes.label: Consider and resolve
recipes.description: Weigh evidence or tradeoffs, then reach a clear recommendation. Do not use to imply certainty unsupported by the text.

recipes.label: Celebrate and appreciate
recipes.description: Recognize meaningful progress, then express warmth or gratitude. Avoid celebration for routine facts.

none.label: Conversation
none.description: Ordinary conversation without a special scene. Includes brief explanations, quoted or hypothetical scene requests, declined research, and literal questions about a car's hood.

deep-research.label: Deep Research
deep-research.description: The user wants a deep dive, thorough investigation, web research, or verification of current external facts with sources. Live chat searches the web and writes a cited answer. Think and enter Tidal Weave while preparing the answer. Begin surfacing when answer text starts arriving, finish the return to Metabloom, then reveal the answer progressively.

under-the-hood.label: Under the Hood
under-the-hood.description: The user playfully asks Metabloom to show a trick, reveal its inner workings, or show what is under the hood. Think, open the orb to reveal the Forward Pass scene, and close it when the reply completes.
